title: NRK Daily feed workflow for AtlasNote
summary: The Norsk experience can import a date-keyed JSON feed generated from user-provided or permitted headline metadata.

blocks.text: The Norsk experience can import a date-keyed JSON feed generated from user-provided or permitted headline metadata.

items: The feed should store URL, publication time, section, short headline-derived study fields and provenance.
Keep source text minimal; do not mirror full articles into the repository.
ChatGPT can return structured translation, vocabulary and grammar hints matching the feed schema.
AtlasNote should treat each date as a lightweight study collection and allow review/mark-as-known.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
